saints.name: St. Faustina Kowalska
saints.title: Virgin
saints.shortBlurb: A humble Polish sister and “secretary” of Divine Mercy, to whom Christ entrusted the message of his boundless mercy…
biography: Helena Kowalska was born near Łódź in Poland in 1905 and entered the Congregation of the Sisters of Our Lady of Mercy, taking the name Maria Faustina. She worked as a cook, gardener, and portress, hiding a rich interior life beneath the most ordinary duties.

In a series of revelations she recorded in her Diary, she reported that Christ appeared to her asking that his mercy be proclaimed to the world, giving the image of the Divine Mercy and the chaplet. She died of tuberculosis in 1938; the devotion she promoted was later approved and the Sunday after Easter established as Divine Mercy Sunday.

sources.text: Vatican biography, Canonization of St. Maria Faustina Kowalska (vatican.va)
